d-11. --fg-disabled is read on two surfaces that pull apart: the disabled Button paints --bg-disabled (= --accent), every other disabled label sits on the page. Mixed from --muted-foreground the button measured 1.95-2.28:1 light / 1.70-1.97:1 dark; re-mixed from --foreground at a fixed 70/65% it cleared 5.25:1 on the five near-neutral presets and then measured 1.04:1 on womens-fashion, whose --accent is a terracotta. One colour cannot serve both surfaces there — light needs luminance >= 0.576 for the button and <= 0.159 for the page — so the percentage is gone: each ink is solved per preset per mode against the surfaces it is read on, taking the MOST muted colour that still clears the target, so a disabled control stays visibly disabled instead of being lifted to enabled contrast.
